author: SickProdigy
description: Connect Discord to MyBB for forum access and verified External Sign-In membership role synchronization.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each guild's MyBB board settings, forum aliases, manager role, membership entitlement-to-role mappings and synchronization state. For linked members it stores the verified MyBB issuer/subject/link identifier, synchronization status/timestamps/errors, and role IDs granted by the cog. API tokens, External Sign-In client credentials, and per-member link credentials are stored separately in Red shared API tokens and removed on deliberate disconnect or user-data deletion.
install_msg: Run `[p]mybbset setup` with Manage Server to connect this Discord server to its MyBB board using a restricted API token. Members can optionally run `[p]mybb connect` for personal access.
name: MyBB
short: Per-server MyBB boards, personal connections, search, and publishing
